Name: Volcán Barú National Park
Brief Description: Panama's highest peak (3475m). Only place to see both Pacific and Caribbean oceans. Cloud forest biodiversity.

Name: Sitio Barriles Archaeological Site
Brief Description: Pre-Columbian ruins (300-900 AD) with unique statues. Barriles culture artifacts.

Name: Lagunas de Volcán
Brief Description: Panama's highest lakes (1240m). Protected wetlands with excellent birdwatching.

Name: Parque Internacional La Amistad
Brief Description: UNESCO World Heritage cloud forest spanning Panama-Costa Rica border. 600+ bird species.

Name: Los Cangilones de Gualaca
Brief Description: Natural rock formations with crystal-clear swimming pools in transition zone.

Name: Playa Las Lajas
Brief Description: 15 km Pacific beach in Gulf of Chiriquí. Sea turtle nesting site. Spectacular sunsets.

Name: Las Lajas Beach Resort
Brief Description: Beachfront resort with pool and restaurant. Stage 125 accommodation.

Name: Gulf of Chiriquí Marine Park
Brief Description: Protected marine area. Humpback whale birthing grounds (Jul-Sep). Coral reefs and islands.

Name: San Félix Ngäbe-Buglé Community
Brief Description: Gateway to indigenous communities in surrounding mountains. Traditional culture.

Name: Iglesia San Francisco de la Montaña
Brief Description: Beautifully preserved baroque church since 1630. National treasure.

Name: Santiago de Veraguas
Brief Description: Provincial capital of Veraguas. Major transport hub. Colonial architecture.

Name: Catedral Santiago Apóstol
Brief Description: Colonial cathedral with remains of independence hero General José de Fábrega.

Name: Museo Regional de Veraguas
Brief Description: 2000+ years of regional history. Pre-Columbian artifacts. Former 1855 prison building.

Name: Hotel Mykonos Santiago
Brief Description: Full-service hotel on Pan-American Highway. Stage 126 accommodation.

Name: Reserva La Yeguada
Brief Description: Protected reserve with pine forests and volcanic crater lake. Camping destination.

Name: Natá de los Caballeros
Brief Description: One of oldest towns in Americas (1522). Basilica is oldest church in continuous use.

Name: El Caño Archaeological Park
Brief Description: Pre-Columbian burial mounds (500-1200 AD). 2011 warrior chief tomb discovery.

Name: Penonomé
Brief Description: Capital of Coclé Province. Colonial charm. Brief former national capital.

Name: Museo de Penonomé
Brief Description: History museum in colonial building. Pre-Columbian pottery and regional traditions.

Name: La Pintada
Brief Description: Artisan village famous for sombreros pintados (painted hats). Cigar factory.

Name: Hotel Coclé Penonomé
Brief Description: 110-room hotel at Iguana Mall. Pool and restaurant. Stage 127 accommodation.

Name: Punta Chame Peninsula
Brief Description: Narrow peninsula with beaches and kitesurfing. Ferry departure point to Panama City.

Name: Amador Causeway
Brief Description: 6 km scenic road built from canal excavation rock. Connects 4 islands. Views of canal entrance.

Name: Panama Canal - Miraflores Locks
Brief Description: World-famous engineering marvel. Observation decks to watch ships transit locks.

Name: Casco Viejo Historic District
Brief Description: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Colonial architecture, cobblestone streets, vibrant culture.

Name: Iglesia de San José - Golden Altar
Brief Description: Church housing legendary Altar de Oro, hidden from pirate Henry Morgan in 1671.

Name: Plaza de Francia
Brief Description: Monument to 22000 canal workers. French Embassy. Beautiful Panama Bay views.

Name: Panama Canal Museum
Brief Description: Comprehensive museum documenting canal history in historic Casco Viejo building.

Name: Biomuseo
Brief Description: Frank Gehry-designed museum exploring Panama's biodiversity. Colorful landmark.

Name: Panama Viejo
Brief Description: UNESCO site. Ruins of original Panama City destroyed by pirates in 1671.

Name: Cerro Ancón
Brief Description: Highest point in Panama City. Panoramic views. Urban rainforest hiking.

Name: Bridge of the Americas
Brief Description: Iconic 1962 bridge spanning Pacific canal entrance. North-South America connection.

Name: Radisson Hotel Panama Canal
Brief Description: Hotel at canal mouth on Amador Causeway. Canal and bridge views. Stage 128 accommodation.
